name: camp_main
source: code read 2026-10-11 (B); emulator: Cross opens it, game_state 3
note: The camp (game_state 3, main calls it each frame). camp_state picks the screen: 1 entry (writes the party's position into each member's Roster.area/x/y/facing), 3 icons, 5 menu, 10 Inspect, 15 Reorganize, 20 Save, 25 Settings, 30 Decipher (only with story_flags bit 0x20000000), 35 leave. Also the 'who takes it' picker for a found item when packs are full (DAT_80079be0 holds the item).

name: menu_cursor
note: Moves a two-axis menu cursor (pointers to the x and y bytes) from the pad; returns 4 confirm, 2 cancel, 5 and 7 next/previous character (L/R).

name: camp_inspect
note: Inspect Character: pick a member, then Cast Spell (only if any spell is known and status < 0x20), Items, Pool Gold, Back. L/R step through the party.

name: camp_cast_spell
source: code read 2026-10-11 (B); emulator test (Dumapic in the field and the Training Maze; Dios on a full-HP ally)
note: Casting outside battle. Pick realm (row, defaults to the class's book), level (column 1-7), spell (one of three). Spell points are per realm and level (Roster+0x5c). Only 26 spells have a camp effect (camp_spell_id). See docs/re/B-camp.md.

name: camp_spell_select
note: 26 code pointers: what camp_cast_spell does when spell id N is chosen (target picker or immediate effect).

name: camp_spell_effect
note: 23 code pointers, for spell ids 3-25: the effect on the chosen target.

name: kandi_regions
note: 12 regions x 9 area ids (-1 pad) for Kandi's answer: Field 0; Shrine Interior 1-4; Underground Shrine 5-8; Area X 18; Area A 19-22; Area B 23-27; Area C 28-31; Area D 32-34; Area E 36-39; Training Maze 9-16; Area G 40-42; group 11 (area 43) answers 'Not in this area'. Region N prints SISETU 0x10d+N.

name: camp_icon_ids
note: Icon numbers for the six camp menu icons (camp_main copies them to the stack).

name: kandi_locate
note: Kandi's answer for a character in the maze: same region as the caster gives floor (not for Field or Area X), N (23 - y) and E (x); otherwise the region's name.

name: status_has
note: Tests a character for a condition: 0 'can be healed' (not dead or ash, HP < max), 1 poison (0x04), 2 paralysis (0x20), 3 stone (0x40), 4 dead (0x80), 5 ash (0x100), 6 afraid (0x01), 7 KO (0x10), 8 confused (0x02), 9 asleep (0x08).

name: camp_spell_failed
note: Prints 'Failed!' (SISETU 284) and spends the spell point. Used for Dumapic, Malor and Loktofeit where they don't work.

name: dice
note: Rolls N dice of S sides and adds B: (N, S, B) -> NdS+B, each die 1..S (rand_below(S)+1).

name: buff_litofeit
note: Litofeit and the Winged Boots: levitation for 1000 steps (0x8007e82e).

name: buff_latumapic
note: Latumapic: identifies monsters for 2000 steps (0x8007e82c), and marks the groups on screen identified.

name: buff_maporfic
note: Maporfic: party AC -2 (0x8007e82a = 2) for 1250 steps (0x8007e828).

name: buff_oslo
note: Oslo: attack boost level 2 (0x8007e830) and 60 more steps (0x8007e832).

name: buff_maoslo
note: Maoslo: attack boost level 2 for 2500 steps.

name: buff_fofic
note: Fofic and the Potion of Fofic: magic defence level 10 (0x8007e834) for 1250 steps (0x8007e836), only if none is running.

name: remove_lost_members
note: After Kadorto leaves someone Lost (status >= 0x200): blanks the record's name, compacts the roster and renumbers every party's members.

name: roster_compact
note: Closes the gap left by a deleted roster record and recounts party_member_count.

name: party_drop_member
note: Removes a roster index from every party record and from the current party, shifting higher indexes down by one.

name: camp_items_menu
note: Items: Identify (Bishops only; greyed for others), Use, Give, Equip, Drop.

name: camp_identify
note: Bishop's Identify in camp: chance (level - item level + 1) x 20%, held to 5-75%. On a miss, a Bishop whose level is no more than twice the item's may touch it: becomes afraid, and a cursed item is equipped and cursed on them. Also shows an identified item's details screen.

name: camp_use_item
source: code read 2026-10-11 (B); emulator test (Potion of Dios on a full-HP ally is used up)
note: Use: effects are hard-coded by item id, not read from the item record. See docs/re/B-camp.md for the list.

name: equip_curse_check
note: Equips one item (sets 0x2000). If the item's alignment bits don't include the wearer's alignment, or its flags05 bit 0x80 is set, it becomes cursed and equipped (0xa000) and returns 2.

name: stat_adjust
note: Changes one stat (0 Str .. 5 Luck) by +/-1, only if the result stays at 3 or more and below the race's base + 13 (+14 for a man's Strength or a woman's Vitality).

name: equip_slot_prompt
note: Lists the candidates for the current equip slot and prompts (SISETU 0xe5 + slot).

name: camp_give
note: Give: equipped items can't be given ('It's equipped...'), cursed ones show 'Cursed!'; a full pack offers a swap.

name: camp_drop
note: Drop: equipped items can't be dropped; ids 310 and up ask 'This is an important item. Drop it?'. Also used to make room for a found item.

name: camp_pool_gold
note: Pool Gold: calls pool_gold.

name: pool_gold
note: Moves every party member's gold onto the chosen character, capped at 0x7fffffff.

name: camp_reorganize
note: Reorganize Party: swap two of the six slots (members and their alignment bytes at 0x8007e81e). Needs two or more members.

name: camp_save
note: Save Adventure: writes the position into each member's roster record, copies the current party (0x8007e810, 0x36 bytes) back into its parties[] record, then hands off to MCARD's save screen (DAT_800796d2 = 0xfa, main sets game_mode 7).

name: camp_settings
note: Camp settings screen: eight rows on config[0..7] (names x3, status, sound output, music, sound effects, effects); toggling music restarts or stops the maze track (0xb).

name: camp_decipher
note: Decipher Ancient Script: the player's own table of 26 ancient letters to A-Z, kept at 0x80089b40 (0xff unset). Only offered once story_flags bit 0x20000000 is set (MCARD 0x800d65c8, talk handler 3).

name: help_line
note: Prints a camp help line: SISETU string N at (x, y) on glyph layer 1.

name: text_at
note: Expands string N of text file T (text_files[T]: 0 STATUS.OBJ, 1 item names, 3 FIGHTMSG, 4 SISETU, 6 NPC text) and draws it at (x, y) on a glyph layer.

name: text_draw
note: Draws an expanded string glyph by glyph (glyph_put), handling ff codes.

name: items_menu_labels
note: Draws the Items menu labels (Identify, Use, Give, Equip, Drop); Identify greyed unless the flag says Bishop.

name: camp_icon
note: Puts one camp menu icon sprite on screen (highlighted or not).

name: spell_camp_ok
note: One byte per spell, realm x 0x15 + level x 3 + slot: above 0 means it's offered (not greyed) in the camp's spell list.

name: camp_state
note: camp_main's screen (see camp_main). main zeroes it when a talk starts.

name: camp_sub_state
note: State of the screen camp_state picked (Inspect's own steps: 10 pick member .. 15 menu .. 20 spells .. 25 items).

name: camp_spell_state
note: camp_cast_spell's step: 5 level, 10 spell, 15 checks, 20 dispatch, 25/30 target, 45 'Spell cast', 50 done, 40 'What?'.

name: camp_spell_id
note: The camp spell chosen: 0 Dumapic, 1 Litofeit, 2 Malor, 3 Dios, 4 Kandi, 5 Latumapic, 6 Dialko, 7 Maporfic, 8 Latumofis, 9 Dial, 10 Dialma, 11 Madi, 12 Kadorto, 13 Madial, 14 Oslo, 15 Maoslo, 16 Fofic, 17 Morfis, 18 Kadios, 19 Diomas, 20 Diafic, 21 Calko, 22 Loktofeit, 23 Madios, 24 Caldu, 25 Ihalon; 0xff not usable in camp.

name: camp_char
note: Roster index of the character acting in camp (caster or item user).

name: camp_target
note: Roster index of the target of a camp spell or item.

name: maze_exit_code
note: What the maze does after the camp closes: 0xfe Dumapic's map, 0xfd Loktofeit (back to the castle), 0xfc Malor (teleport), 0xff plain exit. main reads -1..-4.

name: decipher_table
note: The player's guesses in Decipher Ancient Script: for each of 26 ancient letters, the A-Z index chosen, 0xff unset. Saved (MCARD reads and writes it).

name: buff_maporfic_steps
note: Steps left on Maporfic (current party record +0x18; the per-step routine 0x800c5570 counts it down).

name: buff_maporfic_ac
note: AC bonus while Maporfic runs (2).

name: buff_latumapic_steps
note: Steps left on Latumapic.

name: buff_litofeit_steps
note: Steps left on Litofeit (levitation).

name: buff_oslo_level
note: Attack boost (Oslo, Maoslo); cleared when the steps run out.

name: buff_oslo_steps
note: Steps left on the attack boost.

name: buff_fofic_level
note: Magic defence (Fofic); cleared when the steps run out.

name: buff_fofic_steps
note: Steps left on Fofic.

name: buff_diafic_steps
note: Steps left on Diafic (finds secret doors); set to 232.

name: nomagic_steps
note: Set to 232 on a square whose word in 0x8005b9d0 is negative, counted down each step; while it's above 0, every camp spell fails ('Failed!', point spent).
